# TopCited Skills

> Open-source Agent Skills that audit and optimize a website for search engines (SEO) and AI answer engines (GEO), working with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and other agents that read SKILL.md. Free; no account needed for the audit. Optional TopCited integration adds live AI-citation tracking.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/TopCited/topcited-skills/blob/main/README.md): install for every agent, what each skill does
- [optimize-website skill](https://github.com/TopCited/topcited-skills/blob/main/skills/optimize-website/SKILL.md): audit → ranked fixes → drafted rewrites
- [Per-agent install](https://github.com/TopCited/topcited-skills/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf, OpenClaw, ChatGPT/Claude.ai via MCP

## Knowledge base
- [SEO/GEO knowledge index](https://github.com/TopCited/topcited-skills/blob/main/skills/seo-geo/knowledge/INDEX.md): 30 dated, cited files

## Optional
- [Comparison with other SEO/GEO skill repos](https://github.com/TopCited/topcited-skills/blob/main/docs/comparison.md)
- [TopCited](https://topcited.ai): the paid product these skills can hand off to
